title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Resolution No. 239-38 (COR), which recognizes Patti Arroyo for her dedicated service in keeping the people of Guam informed, her contributions to Guam’s media industry, and her mentorship of local media professionals; and congratulates her on her retirement after thirty (30) years of service. The presentation is scheduled for Friday, November 27, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. at the WAVE 105.1 FM studio in Barrigada Heights.
